scope: One fixed learned per-joint mixture for positions and valid rotations
architecture: Same596 observed curve inputs and32 shared tanh hidden units. Each of17 joints has four position and three rotation softmax weights (119outputs). Frozen v20 learned expert plus existing procedural experts; original v23 and all other candidates stay unchanged.
rotation: Convert linear/Hermite/v20 rotations to unit quaternions, align signs to the linear reference, use a normalized convex quaternion blend with fixed1e-6linear-reference mass to prevent zero norm. Differentiate through normalization and the rotation6 polynomial. Priority transforms are overwritten exactly. No claimed C1 continuity at hemisphere ambiguity.
training: Same group-excluded v20 parent for each row features and experts; targets separate. Joint position Gram loss plus actual normalized-quaternion rotation6 trajectory loss, with original velocity/acceleration weights and equal-cohort weighting.40epochs,batch64,lr.001,L2.0001; one fixed configuration, no grid or retuning.
validation: Pre-fit finite-difference/explicit-loss, proper-rotation/nondegeneracy, exact priorities, stationary/masked/hidden-label/padding invariants and serialization. Freeze before all old/new/combined gates, repeat exactly, actual-rig recovery. Six fresh confirmation clips stay sealed unless gates pass.
goal_policy: Original full endpoint and50total evaluations/15-hour resumed deadline unchanged; no runtime, package, downloads or publication.
